title: Synchronous up/down counter

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, SN54190/SN54191/SN74190/SN74191 (bulletin DL-S 7611865, Dec 1972, rev. Oct 1976)

pins.name: LOAD
pins.text: low: QA..QD take A..D at once, independent of the clock

pins.name: G
pins.text: count enable, active low: high inhibits counting; change it only while CLOCK is high

pins.name: D/U
pins.text: down/up: low counts up, high counts down

functions.text: The four counter bits (QA least significant).

functions.formula: MAX/MIN = (/D/U = L AND Q = 15) OR (/D/U = H AND Q = 0)
functions.text: High-level pulse about one full clock cycle long when the counter overflows (counting up) or underflows (counting down); the timing diagram shows it high at 15 counting up and at 0 counting down.

functions.formula: /RIPPLE CLOCK = NOT (MAX/MIN AND /G = L AND CLOCK = L)
functions.text: Low-level pulse equal in width to the low part of the clock when an overflow or underflow condition exists (datasheet wording); used to cascade into the next counter's enable or clock.

rules: LOAD' low: Q = D,C,B,A at once, independent of the clock (asynchronous)
G' high: counting inhibited, Q holds
G' low, D/U' low: Q = Q + 1 (mod 16) at the rising clock edge
G' low, D/U' high: Q = Q - 1 (mod 16) at the rising clock edge
Change G' and D/U' only while CLOCK is high

electrical.notes: SN74191: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Enable input IIL -4.8 mA (three loads), other inputs -1.6 mA.

stored.name: FA
stored.next: FA = FA XOR (/G AND ((/D/U AND 1) OR (NOT /D/U AND 1)))
